content:
When throwing two standard six-sided dice, each die has faces numbered from 1 to 6. The possible sums when throwing two dice range from 2 (1+1) to 12 (6+6).

Since 13 is outside this range, it is impossible to obtain a sum of 13 when throwing two standard dice.

**Probability of getting 13:**
\[
\boxed{0}
\]
